name: Ode to Ascension
description: At the start of the Action Phase, if you have at least 2 Hexerei Cards on the field: Gain one of the following effects based on your Durin's current Elemental Burst: The next 3 instances of Pyro DMG taken by the opposing side this Round are increased by 1; or, while Durin is your active character, the next instance of Vaporize or Melt Reaction DMG you deal is increased by 3.
